cases.translation: Sarah conceived and bore Abraham a son.
cases.explain: The transitive verb родить takes its direct object in the accusative; for the animate masculine сын the accusative equals the genitive form.

cases.translation: Sarah conceived and bore a son to Abraham.
cases.explain: The recipient of the action (bore a son to Abraham) stands in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Когда его сыну Исааку исполнилось восемь ___.
cases.translation: When his son Isaac was eight days old.
cases.explain: The numeral восемь (eight) governs the genitive plural.

cases.sentence: Через ___ ты будешь иметь потомство, которое я тебе обещал.
cases.translation: Through Isaac you will have the offspring that I promised you.
cases.explain: The preposition через (through) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Не огорчайся из-за мальчика и рабыни, послушайся ___.
cases.translation: Do not be distressed over the boy and the servant; obey Sarah.
cases.explain: The verb послушаться (to obey) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Авраам взял еды и бурдюк с ___ и дал Агаре.
cases.translation: Abraham took food and a skin of water and gave it to Hagar.
cases.explain: The preposition с in the sense 'with / containing' governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Когда вода кончилась, она оставила мальчика под ___.
cases.translation: When the water ran out, she left the boy under a shrub.
cases.explain: The preposition под indicating location takes the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Измаил вырос, поселился в ___ и стал стрелком из лука.
cases.translation: Ishmael grew up, settled in the wilderness, and became an archer.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Сара забеременела и родила Аврааму сына, когда тот уже состарился, в то самое время, как обещал ему Бог.
reading.question: When did Sarah bear Abraham a son?
options: In his old age, at the time God had promised
reading.correct: In his old age, at the time God had promised
reading.explain: The text says she bore him a son 'когда тот уже состарился' (when he had already grown old), at the time God had promised.

reading.ru: Аврааму было сто лет, когда у него родился сын Исаак.
reading.question: How old was Abraham when Isaac was born?
reading.explain: The text says 'Аврааму было сто лет' (Abraham was one hundred years old).

reading.ru: В тот день, когда Исаак был отнят от груди, Авраам устроил большой пир.
reading.question: What did Abraham do on the day Isaac was weaned?
reading.explain: The text says Abraham 'устроил большой пир' (held a great feast).

reading.ru: Тут Бог открыл ей глаза, и она увидела колодец с водой.
reading.question: What did Hagar see when God opened her eyes?
reading.explain: The text says 'она увидела колодец с водой' (she saw a well of water).

reading.ru: Бог был с мальчиком, Измаил вырос, поселился в пустыне и стал стрелком из лука.
reading.question: What did Ishmael become as he grew up?
reading.explain: The text says he 'стал стрелком из лука' (became an archer with a bow).

reading.ru: Авраам привел мелкий и крупный скот и дал Авимелеху, и они заключили союз.
reading.question: What did Abraham and Abimelech do together?
reading.explain: The text says 'они заключили союз' (they made a covenant).
